# Disks:
#   vda (16 GiB) -> /dev/sdq
#   vdb (16 GiB) -> /dev/sdr
#   vdc (16 GiB) -> /dev/sds

# ---- partition ----
# vda -> /dev/sdq: clear the old table and signatures
wipefs --all /dev/sdq
# /dev/sdq: its first 4 MiB zeroed, and its last 1 MiB (a GPT's backup, md 0.90/1.0 superblocks, ZFS's end labels)
dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sdq bs=1M count=4 conv=fsync
sh -c 'n=$(blockdev --getsz /dev/sdq) && dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sdq bs=512 seek=$((n - 2048)) count=2048 conv=fsync'
# the new partitions' old content zeroed through /dev/sdq, before its table names them (blocks of 512 bytes, at their start= sectors)
# vda1: its first 4 MiB and its last 1 MiB
dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sdq bs=512 seek=2048 count=8192 conv=fsync
dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sdq bs=512 seek=2097152 count=2048 conv=fsync
# vda2: its first 4 MiB and its last 1 MiB
dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sdq bs=512 seek=2099200 count=8192 conv=fsync
dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sdq bs=512 seek=33552384 count=2048 conv=fsync
# udev done with /dev/sdq before sfdisk takes it
udevadm settle
sfdisk --wipe always --wipe-partitions always /dev/sdq <<'EOF'
label: dos
label-id: 0xbc000001
unit: sectors
sector-size: 512

/dev/sdq1 : start=2048, size=2097152, type=fd, bootable
/dev/sdq2 : start=2099200, size=31455232, type=fd
EOF
# vdb -> /dev/sdr: clear the old table and signatures
wipefs --all /dev/sdr
# /dev/sdr: its first 4 MiB zeroed, and its last 1 MiB (a GPT's backup, md 0.90/1.0 superblocks, ZFS's end labels)
dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sdr bs=1M count=4 conv=fsync
sh -c 'n=$(blockdev --getsz /dev/sdr) && dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sdr bs=512 seek=$((n - 2048)) count=2048 conv=fsync'
# the new partitions' old content zeroed through /dev/sdr, before its table names them (blocks of 512 bytes, at their start= sectors)
# vdb1: its first 4 MiB and its last 1 MiB
dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sdr bs=512 seek=2048 count=8192 conv=fsync
dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sdr bs=512 seek=2097152 count=2048 conv=fsync
# vdb2: its first 4 MiB and its last 1 MiB
dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sdr bs=512 seek=2099200 count=8192 conv=fsync
dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sdr bs=512 seek=33552384 count=2048 conv=fsync
# udev done with /dev/sdr before sfdisk takes it
udevadm settle
sfdisk --wipe always --wipe-partitions always /dev/sdr <<'EOF'
label: dos
label-id: 0xbc000002
unit: sectors
sector-size: 512

/dev/sdr1 : start=2048, size=2097152, type=fd, bootable
/dev/sdr2 : start=2099200, size=31455232, type=fd
EOF
# vdc -> /dev/sds: clear the old table and signatures
wipefs --all /dev/sds
# /dev/sds: its first 4 MiB zeroed, and its last 1 MiB (a GPT's backup, md 0.90/1.0 superblocks, ZFS's end labels)
dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sds bs=1M count=4 conv=fsync
sh -c 'n=$(blockdev --getsz /dev/sds) && dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sds bs=512 seek=$((n - 2048)) count=2048 conv=fsync'
# the new partitions' old content zeroed through /dev/sds, before its table names them (blocks of 512 bytes, at their start= sectors)
# vdc1: its first 4 MiB and its last 1 MiB
dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sds bs=512 seek=2048 count=8192 conv=fsync

dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sds bs=512 seek=2099200 count=8192 conv=fsync
dd if=/dev/zero of=/dev/sds bs=512 seek=33552384 count=2048 conv=fsync
# udev done with /dev/sds before sfdisk takes it
udevadm settle
sfdisk --wipe always --wipe-partitions always /dev/sds <<'EOF'
label: dos
label-id: 0xbc000003
unit: sectors
sector-size: 512

/dev/sds1 : start=2048, size=2097152, type=fd, bootable
/dev/sds2 : start=2099200, size=31455232, type=fd
EOF
udevadm settle

# ---- assemble ----
# md array md126 (raid1)
mdadm --create /dev/md/boot --run --assume-clean --metadata=1.2 --level=raid1 --raid-devices=3 --uuid=bc000000:00004000:80000000:00000001 --homehost=localhost.localdomain --name=boot --data-offset=2048K --bitmap=internal /dev/sdq1 /dev/sdr1 /dev/sds1

# volume group rl_host-1: its metadata, for pvcreate and vgcfgrestore
cat > /run/bko-holt/lvm/rl_host-1.vg <<'EOF'

				extent_count = 7163
				type = "striped"
				stripe_count = 1
				stripes = ["pv0", 0]
			}
		}
		swap {
			id = "bkoLVM-0000-0000-0000-0000-0000-000004"
			status = ["READ", "WRITE", "VISIBLE"]
			flags = []
			creation_host = "localhost.localdomain"
			creation_time = 1794018729
			segment_count = 1
			segment1 {
				start_extent = 0

# ---- format ----

mkfs.xfs -f -m crc=1,finobt=1,rmapbt=1,reflink=1,inobtcount=1,bigtime=1,uuid=bc000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000009,metadir=0 -i sparse=1,nrext64=1,size=512,exchange=0,maxpct=25 -n ftype=1,size=4096,parent=0 -b size=4096 -s size=512 -d size=1071644672,agsize=267911168 -l lazy-count=1,size=67108864 /dev/md/boot

mkfs.xfs -f -m crc=1,finobt=1,rmapbt=1,reflink=1,inobtcount=1,bigtime=1,uuid=bc000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000000a,metadir=0 -i sparse=1,nrext64=1,size=512,exchange=0,maxpct=25 -n ftype=1,size=4096,parent=0 -b size=4096 -s size=512 -d size=30039605248,agsize=1877475328,sunit=1024,swidth=2048 -l lazy-count=1,size=67108864,su=32768 /dev/mapper/rl_host--1-root
# check: /dev/mapper/rl_host--1-root is xfs with the source's features (read back by bko-holt's own probe)

mkswap -U bc000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000000b --pagesize 4096 /dev/mapper/rl_host--1-swap
